facts.fact: 中文：名单记载有人为了潜入摩门黑手党而与其发生关系。
facts.anchor: in order to infiltrate the Mormon Mafia.

facts.fact: 中文：名单记载有人为了退出“柜中黑手党”而与其发生关系。
facts.anchor: in order to exit the In The Closet Mafia.

facts.fact: 中文：名单记载有人与其发生关系，理由是对方是她来自西弗吉尼亚州Odd的表亲。
facts.anchor: on account of he was her cousin from Odd, West Virginia.

facts.fact: 中文：名单记载作为“大码黑手党”成员，她想挠那“大肥痒”。
facts.anchor: as a member of the Plus Size Mafia, she wanted to scratch that big fat itch.

facts.fact: 中文：名单记载有人说自己是为了维持海军陆战队黑手党的团结与凝聚力。
facts.anchor: in order to maintain the solidarity and cohesiveness of the Marine Corps Mafia, or so he said.

facts.fact: 中文：名单记载有人与已故西弗吉尼亚州参议员Robert Byrd发生关系，理由是他身为美国参议员。
facts.anchor: slept with the late Senator Robert Byrd of West Virginia, seeing as he was a U.S. Senator.

facts.fact: 中文：名单记载有人与ALLNIGHT发生关系，因为他的Funny Name就是ALLNIGHT。
facts.anchor: slept with ALLNIGHT because his Funny Name was ALLNIGHT.

facts.fact: 中文：名单之外还有很多其他配对；不幸的是，人事部门某人误把所有这些档案运到了摩纳哥的一处码头。
facts.anchor: There were lots of other couplings too. Unfortunately, somebody in Personnel accidentally shipped all those files off to a dockside in Monaco.
